text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Communist Party chief Do Muoi has applauded the efforts of Vietnam's coal miners and urged them to step up production.
-- Vietnam's new planning and investment minister Tran Xuan Gia says Hanoi has licensed 1,570 foreign investment projects since 1988 with total capital of $24.7 billion.
-- The United Nations Development Programme and the government of Denmark have granted Vietnam $9 million to help develop its legal system.
-- Thailand's Commander-in-Chief has visited Vietnam to strengthen military relations.
